title: Senior Analyst (Medical Analytics) – ML Solution Owner
description:
**Job Title: Senior Analyst (Medical Analytics) – ML Solution Owner**
---------------------------------------------------------------------

**Career Level: D1**
--------------------

**Introduction to role:**
-------------------------

Are you ready to own high-impact ML solutions that guide medical strategy and accelerate decisions across our enterprise? You will lead production-grade analytics products in this role. These products extract signals from complex data to guide Medical, Commercial, Clinical Operations, and other teams. This helps drive faster, more consistent decisions that benefit individuals we serve and the organization.

You will translate real collaborator needs into scalable, secure solutions that combine robust engineering with advanced ML and generative AI. Join us at a pivotal moment as we invest in automation, modern data platforms and intelligent products to power the next chapter of growth. Would you thrive leading a multidisciplinary team to deliver tools that clinicians and leaders trust every day?

**Accountabilities****:**
-------------------------

* Solution Ownership & Delivery: Act as the primary owner for assigned analytics and ML solutions, ensuring end-to-end delivery with high quality and agility; collaborate with partners to translate business needs into scalable, production-ready solutions; architect and lead all aspects of data pipelines, ML models and application workflows; maintain detailed documentation, business logic mapping and release notes; ensure compliance with data governance, privacy and security standards.
* Machine Learning & Advanced Analytics: Lead the building, creation and assessment of ML models for predictive analytics, classification and regression, NLP (topic modeling, summarization, extraction), recommendation engines and time-series forecasting; drive experimentation, testing, model optimization and explainability; leverage LLMs and generative AI for automation, summarization and insight extraction; evaluate and integrate new ML libraries, frameworks and platforms.
* Application Development & UI Engineering: Lead development of web-based UIs, dashboards and decision-support tools using Replit; Python with Flask/FastAPI; React, Streamlit or Dash; partner with application engineers to build end-to-end user experiences that integrate ML outputs; ensure applications are responsive, intuitive and performance-optimized.
* Team Leadership & Mentorship: Lead a team of six mid-level and junior data analysts, data scientists and application engineers; provide daily mentorship, code reviews, technical coaching and priority setting; foster an environment of creativity, ongoing development and high technical standards; coordinate workload planning, delivery timelines and critical issue management .
* Data Engineering & Integration: Guide develop of data pipelines, feature engineering workflows and cloud-based integrations; work with engineers to connect to structured and unstructured datasets (CSV, Excel, APIs, Databricks, SQL databases); ensure data quality, versioning and reproducibility.
* Collaborator Management & Communication: Act as the main point of contact for business partners on solution scope, achievements, risks and timelines; present analyses, model outcomes and product demos to leadership teams; influence decision-making through clear, actionable communication.
* Innovation & Continuous Improvement: Evaluate new technologies (LLMs, MLOps, AutoML, similarity search databases, Vibe Coding, advanced application frameworks); proactively propose POCs, quick prototypes and new analytics capabilities with measurable business value; drive adoption of modern development practices (CI/CD, GitHub workflows, model monitoring).

**Essential Skills/Experience:**
--------------------------------

**Education & Experience:**
---------------------------

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Data Science, Statistics, or related fields.
* 8–10 years of experience in analytics, machine learning, or solution delivery.
* Proven experience leading small to medium technical teams.

**Technical Skills:**
---------------------

* Strong programming skills in Python (pandas, scikit‑learn, numpy, spaCy, transformers).
* Experience in ML model development, deployment, and monitoring.
* Strong knowledge of SQL and at least one cloud platform (Azure preferred).
* Experience with Databricks, PySpark, or equivalent big‑data engines.
* Ability to build applications using Replit, Streamlit, Flask/FastAPI, or React.
* Familiarity with healthcare/pharma datasets (IQVIA, EMR, claims, real‑world evidence).

**Solution Ownership Skills**
-----------------------------

* Strong understanding of solution architecture, software development lifecycle, and delivery governance.
* Ability to translate business needs into technical requirements.
* Strong documentation, estimation, scoping, and dependency‑management skills.

**Leadership & Soft Skills:**
-----------------------------

* Excellent communication, collaborator management, and mentorship capabilities.
* Ability to present insights and technical concepts to non‑technical audiences.
* Strong problem‑solving skills with a bias toward action and innovation.
* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

**Desirable Skills/Experience:**
--------------------------------

* Experience deploying ML models via containers, serverless functions, or MLflow.
* Knowledge of MLOps, CI/CD workflows, GitHub Actions.
* Hands‑on experience with LLMs, prompt engineering, and generative AI tools.
* Exposure to next‑gen development tools (Vibe Coding, AI‑assisted app development).
* Experience with NLP models for summarization, named entity recognition, Q&A systems.
* Knowledge of oncology, medical affairs, or commercial pharma analytics.
* Certifications in AI/ML, cloud, or data engineering.

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world.

**Why AstraZeneca:**
--------------------

Here you will help shape a tech-enabled enterprise where ambitious ideas become real solutions that speed decisions and free our scientists and clinicians to focus on what matters most—patients. We combine new data science with disciplined engineering. We bring diverse experts together to challenge assumptions and move quickly. We invest in modern automation to turn insight into action. You will join a global, collaborative network that values kindness alongside ambition, gives you the trust and accountability to own outcomes, and backs your curiosity with the scale and support to learn, experiment and deliver impact that’s felt well beyond your team.

Own the next wave of ML products that turn sophisticated medical data into decisive action—submit your application and help us deliver faster, smarter decisions for patients and the business.

title: Associate Director, AI
description:
**Job Title: Associate Director, AI**

**Global Career Level: E**

**About our Team:**

Predictive AI and Data team is responsible for providing AI and Bioinformatics solutions to the scientists across the spectrum of drug development and discovery in AstraZeneca (both pre-clinical and clinical stages). The primary aim is to find ways to accelerate the drug development process by leveraging existing company data in combination with the most cutting-edge AI approaches in day-to-day scientific work across the company.

**Introduction to role:**  
As Associate Director, AI, you will be accountable for hands-on design and deployment of advanced Machine Learning and AI solutions used for processing, analysis and interpretation of transcriptomics (as well as proteomics and cell painting) data within toxicological safety domains. You will then help build out the robust solution in production in collaboration with other data science and software developer teams across European and Asian R&D hubs.

**Accountabilities:**

* Collaborate with scientists from across the company to understand their challenges and work with them to build the platform that underpins their research.
* Take responsibility for designing, and deploying machine learning models for a large-scale analysis of clinical transcriptomics data
* Design and build machine learning models for transcriptomics data to predict the risk of clinical events, patient segmentation, or for high-throughput compound screening
* Apply a range of data science methodologies, developing novel data science solutions where off-the-shelf methodologies do not fit
* Build and manage effective relationships with stakeholders to ensure utilization and value of information resources and services. Clearly and objectively communicate results, as well as their associated uncertainties and limitations to shape solutions
* Work effectively across several timezones with AI research teams in China, India and Europe, communicating the requirements for the AI models and evaluating the available solutions
* Champion a “production first attitude” to ensure the necessary infrastructure and platforms are available to scale exploratory research to production.
* Be a part of a hard-working team, continuously improving AstraZeneca’s Machine Learning development environments, platforms, and tooling.
* Work closely and collaboratively with internal governance and compliance functions such as Cyber Security and Data Privacy to secure the computing environment without obstructing end-user productivity.

**Essential Skills/Experience:**  

* PhD (or equivalent years of experience) in mathematics, computer science, engineering, physics, statistics, computational sciences or a related field.

* Proven experience in applying AI and machine learning to solve problems in commercial context
* Demonstrated experience in implementing machine learning/AI workflows to automate bioinformatics analysis pipelines, ideally in the Pharma and/or Healthcare space
* Familiarity with modern foundation models for biological data (e.g., transcriptomics or Cell Painting)
* Experience of manipulating and analysing large high dimensionality unstructured datasets, drawing conclusions, defining recommended actions, and reporting results across stakeholders
* Advanced skills in programming languages such as Python, and experience with AI libraries and frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch).
* Strong knowledge of software development and machine learning deployment principles
* Demonstratable experience working with AWS or a similar cloud environment
* Experience working in a team with ML engineers and/or software developers
* Familiarity with GitHub, CI/CD pipeline, and best DevOps and MLOps practices
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey complex technical concepts to non-technical partners.
* Strong leadership and project management skills, with a track record of leading successful bioinformatics projects
* Knowledge of AI ethics and responsible AI practices

**Desirable Skills/Experience:**  

* Experience building ML/AI models to predict compound safety

* Experience in life sciences, healthcare, or pharmaceutical industry.
* Familiarity with existing machine vision models: CNNs, vision transformers, diffusion models etc. for self-supervised and multimodal training (e.g., ResNet, UNet, DINO, CLIP, Stable Diffusion)
* Experience working with proteomics datasets
* Experience in a complex global organization.
* Experience working in an Agile team with knowledge or experience of working in product or platform-focused delivery

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world.

**Why AstraZeneca:**

Here, curiosity and courage meet practical impact. We combine digital, data science and AI with deep biological insight to tackle complex disease, investing to better predict clinical success and move programs with pace. You will join a collaborative environment where unexpected teams come together to unlock breakthrough ideas, where kindness sits alongside ambition, and where your production-grade solutions can shape the future of healthcare for patients worldwide.

**Call to Action:**

Ready to build and scale AI that changes how we understand disease and accelerates therapies—take the next step today and shape breakthroughs that matter!

Inviting applications for the role of Manager – Data Scientist.  
In this role, The Data Scientist will apply advanced analytics, machine learning, and statistical modeling to generate actionable insights and solve complex business problems. The role involves data collection, cleaning, exploratory analysis, feature engineering, model development, and integration of AI/ML solutions into dashboards and applications. The Data Scientist collaborates with cross-functional teams to ensure models are aligned with business objectives, reproducible, and scalable.  
This role supports initiatives such as demand forecasting, classification, workforce analytics. By leveraging predictive modelling, NLP, and AI-driven insights, the Data Scientist helps to make data-driven decisions, optimize operations, and enhance customer and employee experiences across its multinational business functions.

Responsibilities  

* Model Development & Statistical Analysis - Design, develop, and optimize machine learning, deep learning, and statistical models to solve complex business problems.
* GenAI & LLM Integration – Implement and integrate AI/ML models into GenAI and Agentic AI applications using LangChain, LangGraph, OpenAI APIs, RAG pipelines, and vector databases.
* End-to-End ML Pipelines – Build, deploy, and maintain scalable ML pipelines, from data ingestion and preprocessing to model deployment, monitoring, and lifecycle management.
* Production Deployment & MLOps – Deploy models as APIs or services using Docker, Kubernetes, FastAPI, and cloud platforms (AWS SageMaker, GCP Vertex AI, Azure ML) while implementing CI/CD for automated testing and versioning.
* Performance Monitoring & Reliability – Monitor model performance in production, detect drift or degradation, and establish alerting mechanisms to ensure reliability, compliance, and governance.
* Analytics Integration – Embed models into real-time dashboards and analytics applications to deliver actionable insights for business and HR stakeholders.
* Governance & Compliance – Ensure model explainability (XAI), security, audit logging, and adherence to ethical, regulatory, and enterprise standards.
* Knowledge Sharing - Conduct and participate in training sessions, workshops, and technical discussions to share insights, AI/ML techniques, and best practices with team members.
* Stakeholder Communication - Translate complex model results, analytics, and AI-driven insights into clear, actionable recommendations for business and non-technical stakeholders.
* Documentation & Enablement - Create well-structured documentation, reproducible workflows, and explanatory reports to support model adoption, operational handovers, and team learning.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration - Works closely with senior data scientists, engineers, and product teams to implement AI/ML solutions, ensuring alignment with project requirements and business objectives.
* Independent Contribution - Executes tasks such as data cleaning, exploratory analysis, feature engineering, and baseline model development under guidance, contributing to end-to-end AI/ML workflows
* Stakeholder Alignment - Assists in presenting findings, visualizations, and insights to business and HR stakeholders, translating technical results into actionable recommendations.

Qualifications We Seek in You!  
Minimum Qualifications / Skills  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in data science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field.
* Years of hands-on experience in data analysis, machine learning, or AI projects, preferably in corporate or academic settings.
* Certification in areas like GenAI, Databricks etc.

Preferred Qualifications / Skills  

* Hands-on experience in data preprocessing, exploratory data analysis, and feature engineering to support ML and AI model development.
* Knowledge of machine learning, deep learning, and NLP techniques for classification, regression, clustering, and predictive modelling.
* Proficiency in Python, SQL, ML/DL frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn), and familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and data visualization tools.
* Experience integrating models into dashboards, analytics tools, and prototype AI applications.
* Familiarity with MLOps practices, model monitoring, CI/CD workflows, and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
* Ability to translate business problems into data-driven solutions and communicate insights to stakeholders effectively.

Why join Genpact?  

* Be a transformation leader – Work at the cutting edge of AI, automation, and digital innovation
* Make an impact – Drive change for global enterprises and solve business challenges that matter
* Accelerate your career – Get hands-on experience, mentorship, and continuous learning opportunities
* Work with the best – Join 140,000+ bold thinkers and problem-solvers who push boundaries every day
* Thrive in a values-driven culture – Our courage, curiosity, and incisiveness - built on a foundation of integrity and inclusion - allow your ideas to fuel progress

Come join the tech shapers and growth makers at Genpact and take your career in the only direction that matters: Up.  
Let’s build tomorrow together.
